tools.name: github_pipeline
tools.description: Generate, commit, and push a GitHub Actions pipeline to a repository branch.

repo_url.description: Optional HTTPS GitHub repository URL; defaults to Micro-DevOps/service-a.

pipeline_name.description: Workflow filename without folders; .yml is added.

branch_name.description: Target Git branch to commit and push the workflow to.

prompt.description: Pipeline requirements used to generate the GitHub Actions workflow.

organization.description: Optional GitHub organization or repository owner, used with repository.

repository.description: Optional GitHub repository name, used with organization.
